steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Thu Nhan, a wood element seed sprout creature that grows into a tree giant, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: its little root feet wiggling toward the food; (3) EAT: digging its roots into the food on the floor; (4) EAT: glowing green while absorbing it, leaves perking up. Row 2: (5) EAT: a new leaf sprouting on its head, very happy; (6) PLAY: wiggling side to side; (7) PLAY: hopping on its root feet; (8) PLAY: spinning on the spot like a top, leaves whirling. Row 3: (9) PLAY: a little dance swinging its leaf arms; (10) PLAY: planting its feet, arms up like branches; (11) PLAY: cheering with sparkling leaves; (12) REFUSE food: folding its leaves over its face. Row 4: (13) PETTED: leaves blushing pink, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving a little leaf; (15) SAD: leaves wilting, slumped; (16) ANGRY: bark cracking, leaves standing stiff.
